hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -Eq '(^|[^a-zA-Z])(grep|rg)([^a-zA-Z]|$)' && ! echo "$cmd" | grep -q 'ast-grep'; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"REMINDER: CLAUDE.md rule - prefer ast-grep over grep/rg for code searches. Only use grep/rg for non-code files (logs, configs, docs)."}}'; fi

printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"REMINDER: CLAUDE.md rule - prefer ast-grep for code searches. Only use the Grep tool for non-code files (logs, configs, docs)."}}'

input=$(cat); cwd=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.cwd // empty'); stop_active=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.stop_hook_active // false'); if [ "$stop_active" = "true" ] || [ -z "$cwd" ]; then exit 0; fi; common_dir=$(git -C "$cwd" rev-parse --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; head_sha=$(git -C "$cwd" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; state_dir="$common_dir/claude-reflect"; mkdir -p "$state_dir"; state_file="$state_dir/last-sha"; last_sha=""; [ -f "$state_file" ] && last_sha=$(cat "$state_file"); if [ "$last_sha" = "$head_sha" ]; then exit 0; fi; printf '%s' "$head_sha" > "$state_file"; range="$head_sha"; if [ -n "$last_sha" ] && git -C "$cwd" cat-file -e "$last_sha" 2>/dev/null; then range="$last_sha..$head_sha"; fi; reason="A commit just landed in this repo (range: $range). Launch a background Agent to reflect on whether the CLAUDE.md files or repo tooling (Makefile targets, lint config, CI workflows, scripts, hooks) have a concrete gap this change exposed: 1) would a doc or tooling improvement have made this change faster or safer to implement or a related question easier to answer; 2) did the pull request need multiple pushes to go green (check gh pr checks and gh run list output plus the commit log for fixup commits) and if so what local check would have caught it before pushing. Give the agent the commit range and this context so it does not need to rediscover it. Tell it that if nothing is worth flagging it should do nothing and report that back. If something is worthwhile, it should use EnterWorktree for a fresh branch off main, open a tracking issue, edit ONLY CLAUDE.md or tooling files, commit, push, and open a separate non-draft PR referencing the issue, kept independent of the code change PR. Do not do this work yourself inline, delegate it so this turn can finish."; jq -n --arg reason "$reason" '{"decision":"block","reason":$reason}'
